title: Dash will not connect after updating phone to android 16
body: Here is the sequence of events: (1) I have been using version 3.3.2.1 on android 15 on motorola edge 2023 plus phone. I was not using BT bonding and never had connection issues. I have been using this setup for approximately a year. (2) A few days ago, I updated my phone to android 16 right before a pod switch. I tried to connect a pod and the pod would not initialize to insert canula. (3) After pod failed to initialize, I deactivated pod and tried another. This one also did not work, so I went looks at the docs and saw that version 3.4 or greater is required with android 16. (4) I downloaded version 3.4.2.2 and tried another pod which did not work. I posted my issues to the discord channel and turned off nearby device location and changed my bluetooth settings to be unrestricted as recommended by the community. (5) I tried again with another pod. This pod initialized, inserted canula and thought I was good to go. After inserting canula, I realized that I had not imported my preferences after updating. I realized this because the app was giving me temp basal acceptance messages like when I started AAPS and had not completed the objectives. (6) After realizing this, I imported objectives. The pod was still delivering basal but I could not communicate with it. This is the pod I have on currently. (7) I decided to try another pod today. I kept the previous pod on to at least get basal from it. I told AAPS to deactivate pod. I started another pod. When initialing it asked me if I wanted to use TWI paring (I have never seen this request before). I looked in the docs for something about this and could not find anything so I ignored the request. After the canula inserted, I received a message saying something similar to "failed to send basal". After this, there was no pod connection yet again. (8) Currently I have on a pod delivering basal (see 6) which I will keep on until I have this figured out and know I can successfully start a new pod. I cannot afford to lose another one. **I'm not sure if I imported the logs properly. Please let me know what I need to do or if I am missing something obvious. Thanks!
